may you bring with you a homeschool atmosphere and self-fulfillment within the campus's shelter.

This handbook tells you where to go and what is offered in the University. Do not hesitate to keep in touch and consult with the Director/ Chairperson for Student Affairs and Services, the Deans/Associate Deans, and the other university officials responsible for your welfare and whose roles are laid out here. Use this handbook as a guide in finding the right person to help you with any university-related concerns. We remain our relationship with students transparent.

Provided with this guide, we wish our students to live by the LSPU core values. The University prides itself on being friendly, just as it is intellectually ambitious and innovative at the same time. Likewise, we expect you to help promote the LSPU culture of honesty, courtesy, and politeness.

trace.answer_for_eval:
To enroll in LSPU as a new student, you should:

1. Satisfy the admission requirements, which include submitting a report card (DepEd Form 138 or Form 137) or its equivalent, along with other documents such as a good moral certificate, medical certificate, and photographs.
2. Take the entrance examination and interview, and obtain a passing rate.
3. Seek guidance from the Guidance Office or the Office of the Registrar for specific document requirements and procedures.
4. Visit the LSPU Student Portal at myaccount.lspu.edu.ph to activate your official student account after enrollment.
5. Enroll either on-site at the Office of the Registrar or through online registration if applicable, in subjects approved by the Registration Adviser/Program Coordinator/College Dean.
6. For on-site registration, go to the Office of the Registrar and register only in approved subjects, with initials from the authorized personnel on your registration form.
7. Use the Student Portal to enlist subjects, check enrollment status, and view your Certificate of Registration.

Note: Confirm the specific documents and procedures with the Guidance Office or Registrar, as some requirements may vary.
